game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Sand Dunes – Palm Grove, a palm grove: the camel trader must handle dust devils while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Algorithm Race: Choose the faster of two approaches (loop vs formula) to out-pace a rival process.
theme: Sand Dunes – Palm Grove: a palm grove
core_gameplay_loop: In Palm Grove, repeat each round: Choose the faster of two approaches (loop vs formula) to out-pace a rival process. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the speed value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the oasis using at most 18 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 18 before the oasis is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 8 (extended tier): Algorithm Race
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Algorithm Race' (Week 9 slot 12), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Palm Grove'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how speed changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against dust devils in Palm Grove.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The oasis reached with actions_used <= 18.
